paragraphs.chinese:
这一集讲的是，父母用不同的方式帮助孩子。克莱尔觉得孩子需要一直被监督，而菲尔和杰则认为，给他们一点空间和支持也许会更有效。

在邓菲家，卢克有一个关于文森特·梵高的作业，第二天就要交；海莉则需要为学校募捐活动做四十个纸杯蛋糕。克莱尔负责指导海莉，并让菲尔盯着卢克，确保他专心完成作业。

菲尔说，自己不想整晚站在卢克身边监视他。他准备先给一点指导，然后让卢克独立完成。问题是，菲尔自己甚至比卢克更容易分心。他不断丢下作业，跑去修理家里的各种东西，克莱尔也越来越确信，卢克最后什么都做不完。

克莱尔对待海莉的方式完全相反。她先教海莉怎样做纸杯蛋糕，可海莉不断犯一些小错误，直到克莱尔干脆接手，自己完成了大部分工作。

后来，克莱尔走进卢克的房间，本以为会看到一场灾难。结果，她发现了一个很有创意、也很有条理的展示板，而且大部分都是卢克自己完成的。她意识到菲尔相信卢克是对的，也为自己没有给孩子足够信任而道歉。随后，她让海莉自己完成剩下的纸杯蛋糕。海莉确实做完了，但味道糟糕到全家人等她离开后，立刻把嘴里的蛋糕吐了出来。

与此同时，米切尔和杰准备一起去看流星雨，这是两个人多年来一直保留的活动。米切尔期待和父亲安静地单独相处，却发现杰还把曼尼带了过来。

曼尼希望米切尔能像对待亲弟弟一样对待自己。杰告诉他，兄弟表达感情的方式就是互相取笑。曼尼把这个建议执行得有些过头。米切尔被臭鼬喷到后，杰和曼尼一直拿他开玩笑，米切尔越来越生气，想直接回家。

杰最后解释说，曼尼没有被邀请参加一个聚会，因为有些孩子觉得他很奇怪。杰不知道该怎么和他谈这件事，所以才把曼尼带来，因为他觉得米切尔会理解。后来，米切尔告诉曼尼，自己小时候同样被别人说成怪人。他说，等人长大以后，那些与众不同的地方，反而可能会成为自己引以为傲的东西。

几个男人外出时，卡梅隆带格洛丽亚去吃晚饭，因为他希望两个人能变得更亲近。他太想给她留下好印象了，甚至在格洛丽亚提醒之后，仍然点了一道极辣的菜，结果几乎吃不下去。

等卡梅隆不再拼命表现以后，两个人终于放松下来。格洛丽亚分享了一件让自己感到内疚的事，卡梅隆马上就理解了她。那天晚上结束时，格洛丽亚告诉他，其实他们早就已经是朋友了。

没有任何人的计划完全按照预想发展，但卢克赢得了克莱尔的信任，曼尼找到了一个真正理解自己的人，而卡梅隆也明白了，友谊不需要强行制造。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is about parents trying to help their children in different ways. Claire believes the kids need constant supervision, while Phil and Jay think a little space and support may work better.

At the Dunphy house, Luke has a project about Vincent van Gogh due the next day, and Haley needs to make forty cupcakes for a school fundraiser. Claire takes charge of Haley and asks Phil to keep Luke focused.

Phil says he doesn’t want to stand over Luke all night. He plans to give him some guidance and let him work independently. The problem is that Phil gets distracted even more easily than Luke. He keeps leaving the project to fix things around the house, and Claire becomes sure that Luke won’t finish anything.

Claire handles Haley very differently. She shows her how to make the cupcakes, but Haley keeps making small mistakes until Claire takes over and does most of the work herself.

Later, Claire goes into Luke’s room expecting a disaster. Instead, she finds a creative and well-organized display that he made mostly by himself. She realizes that Phil was right to trust him and apologizes for not giving Luke enough credit. She then tells Haley to finish her own cupcakes. Haley does, but they taste so terrible that the family waits until she leaves before spitting them out.

Meanwhile, Mitchell and Jay are going to watch a meteor shower, something they’ve done together for years. Mitchell expects some quiet time with his father, but Jay brings Manny along.

Manny wants Mitchell to treat him like a brother, and Jay tells him that brothers show affection by making fun of each other. Manny follows that advice a little too well. After Mitchell gets sprayed by a skunk, Jay and Manny keep teasing him. Mitchell becomes angry and wants to go home.

Jay finally explains that Manny wasn’t invited to a party because some children think he’s weird. Jay doesn’t know how to talk to him about it, so he brought Manny along because he thought Mitchell would understand. Mitchell later tells Manny that he was called weird as a child too. He says that when people grow up, being different can become something they’re proud of.

While the boys are out, Cameron takes Gloria to dinner because he wants them to become closer. He tries too hard to impress her and orders an extremely spicy dish, even after she warns him not to. He can barely finish it.

Once Cameron stops trying so hard, they finally relax. Gloria shares something she feels guilty about, and Cameron understands immediately. By the end of the night, she tells him that they’re already friends.

Nobody’s plan works exactly as expected, but Luke earns Claire’s trust, Manny finds someone who understands him, and Cameron learns that friendship doesn’t need to be forced.
